video_caption: The video opens with a man in a dark grey t-shirt and a dark beard, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression, speaking. To his left, an image appears, featuring a black-and-white silhouette of martial artist Bruce Lee on the right side. On the left side of the image, a quote is displayed in blue text that reads: "Mistakes are always forgivable, if one has the courage to admit them." This is attributed to "Bruce Lee" at the bottom of the quote. Behind the man, a blue wall is visible, adorned with various shelves holding decorative objects. The scene then transitions to a dark green chalkboard background with a white chalk outline of a human brain. This quickly changes to a white background with a brain represented by a network of colorful interconnected dots, with the word "THUNK" in gray appearing over it. Another rapid transition shows a green wireframe brain on a dark green background, again with the word "THUNK" in a darker shade. Finally, the screen displays a simplified black-and-white outline drawing of a brain on a white background, with the large black text "THUNK" superimposed over it, and below it, the episode title "158. On the Virtues of Wiggle Room."

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a gray t-shirt, stands in front of a blue wall with wooden shelves spelling out "THINK" decorated with various objects. He looks directly at the camera and speaks, using expressive facial gestures. From 0:06 to 0:26, two rectangular images appear on either side of him: on the left, a blurry, blue-toned image of a person running and pushing a luggage cart in an airport, and on the right, a woman with dark curly hair wearing a white sweater and a patterned skirt sitting in an airport waiting area, looking at her phone.

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, stands in front of a blue wall adorned with shelves holding various objects. He maintains eye contact with the viewer while speaking. To his left, an embedded video frame titled "Episode 97 Autonomous Vehicle... Ethics?" shows a white Google self-driving car next to a revolver. To his right, another embedded video frame titled "Episode 136 Engineering Wisdom: Tolerance & Failing Gracefully" displays a diagram of a bolt connecting two plates, one blue and one orange. Both frames feature a "THUNK" logo with a stylized brain. Around the 0:11 mark, the left video frame disappears, and the man gestures with his hands at chest height, palms facing each other, as if indicating a small space. At 0:22, the content of the right video frame changes to a close-up shot of a drill bit actively drilling into a metal surface, with metal shavings visible around the drill. At 0:31, the man's eyes widen slightly as he continues talking, and the right video frame further updates to show the drill bit still working, with an orange nozzle directing air or coolant, followed by a white thumbs-up icon and the text "Close enough!".

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, stands in front of a blue wall adorned with wooden shelves spelling out "THINK" and holding various decorative objects. He speaks directly to the camera with a serious expression. In the bottom left corner, an overlay shows a white Google self-driving car next to a revolver, with the text "Episode 97" and "Autonomous Vehicle...Ethics?", and a blue brain logo with "THUNK" written on it. From 0:07, a second, larger overlay appears on the right side of the screen, depicting a person bungee jumping off a high cliff amidst lush greenery. Text overlaid on the bungee jumping scene first shows "867.3 N" (representing Newtons of force), which then changes to "3469.2 N" and, below it, "86X N" with the 'X' in red and crossed out, visually illustrating the concept of applying a safety factor in engineering calculations.

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a grey t-shirt, stands in front of a blue wall with a wooden shelf structure spelling "THINK BOX" that holds various trinkets like a miniature TARDIS, a green creature, and a spherical object. From the beginning until 0:43, he looks directly at the camera, speaking with a serious but engaging expression, occasionally blinking and moving his mouth. At 0:43, an image appears on the right side of the screen, showing two identical grey metal components, one above the other. The top component has four dollar signs ("$$$$") above it, while the bottom component has two dollar signs ("$$") and a downward-pointing red arrow, visually representing a reduction in cost. At 0:59, the scene shifts, and an image appears on the left side of the screen, showing a classic Nokia 3310 mobile phone. This image then changes to the Nokia phone taped to a white cylindrical handle, forming a hammer, with handwritten text on the handle that reads "Nokia 3310 (ULTIMATE WEAPON)". During these visual insertions, the man continues to speak, his gaze shifting slightly to acknowledge the on-screen graphics, and his expression remains consistent. At 1:12, the graphical overlays disappear, and the man is once again the sole focus, continuing his speech until the segment ends.

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, stands in front of a blue wall adorned with large, light brown wooden letters spelling "THINK," which also function as shelves holding various small, colorful objects. He speaks directly to the camera. At 0:09, a wooden sliding square puzzle (known as a 15 puzzle) appears on the left side of the screen, showing numbered squares (1-13, 15, 14) and a single empty space at the bottom right, highlighted by a red arrow pointing to it. The puzzle then changes at 0:21, displaying two empty spaces at the bottom, before changing again at 0:23 to a smaller 3x3 puzzle with eight numbered squares (1-8) and two empty spaces at the bottom. At 0:26, the screen splits horizontally, with the smaller 3x3 puzzle on the left (with two empty spaces) and the original 4x4 15 puzzle on the right, now solved with all numbers in order and one empty space at the bottom right. The man continues speaking in the center. Finally, at 0:41, the puzzles disappear, and the man is seen against the full background again.

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, stands centered in the frame, looking directly at the camera and speaking against a vibrant blue wall adorned with wooden shelves that spell out "THINK" and hold various decorative items like figurines, a helmet, and scientific-looking gadgets. From 0:04, a white text box appears on the right side of the screen, displaying the title "Some Consequences of Having Too Little," followed by the authors Anuj K. Shah, Sendhil Mullainathan, and Elder Shafir, and a paragraph explaining that "Poor individuals often engage in behaviors, such as excessive borrowing, that reinforce the conditions of poverty," and that "scarcity changes how people allocate attention," leading to "attentional shifts that can help to explain behaviors such as overborrowing." The man articulates the concepts, occasionally nodding. Around 0:21, the text box is replaced by an image of a game board resembling "Wheel of Fortune" in the bottom left, showing a partial puzzle "E V L T I N" with the category "ORIGIN OF SPECIES" below it. The man gestures with his hands as he explains the game scenario, making a peace sign with both hands at 0:46 before continuing to speak. At 0:51, the game board is replaced by a bar chart on the right, titled "Points Earned (z-scored)," comparing "Poor" and "Rich" groups with "No Borrowing" (dark bars) and "Borrowing" (white bars). The chart illustrates that "Poor" players earned more points when not borrowing, while "Rich" players had slightly positive points when not borrowing and slightly negative when borrowing, with the "Poor" borrowing group showing significantly lower scores. The man concludes by emphasizing the "advantages of wiggle room," maintaining eye contact with the camera.

A man with dark hair and a beard, wearing a dark gray t-shirt, is speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face, his eyes widening slightly at times to emphasize his words. Behind him, against a blue wall, is a large wooden shelf unit spelling out the word "THINK." Each letter of the word is a compartment filled with various eclectic objects: the "T" holds a clear liquid-filled tube and a small orange figurine; the "H" displays a yellow object resembling a hard hat, a blue box, and a gray robot figure; the "I" contains a white furry creature, a blue-clad female figurine, and a dark rock; the "N" features a circular object with an eye design, a green frog-like figure, and a golden symbol; and the "K" shows a purple ornate vessel, a white figurine, and a brown skull, with a dark helmet resting on top of the letter.

A man with dark hair, a beard, and a dark grey t-shirt stands centered against a blue wall adorned with wooden shelves that spell out "THINK" and hold various trinkets. He maintains eye contact with the camera while speaking. Around the 0:03 mark, a book cover titled "THE BLACK SWAN: THE IMPACT OF THE HIGHLY IMPROBABLE" by Nassim Nicholas Taleb appears to his left. Shortly after, at 0:11, a red line graph is overlaid to his right, showing fluctuating data points over time, with a red shaded area and two dashed lines representing the expected range of values. A red arrow then appears, pointing to an extreme peak in the graph that extends beyond the shaded area, signifying an unexpected event. Around 0:34, the book cover disappears, and a different graph, illustrating "Water level" categories such as "Ordinary," "Rising," "Flood," and "Lasting flood," replaces the previous graph to his right. A red arrow on this graph points to the "Flood water level," indicating a predicted maximum. Simultaneously, a dynamic image of a massive river flood, with turbulent water overflowing its banks and submerging trees, is overlaid to his left, visually contrasting the theoretical flood level on the graph with a real-world, likely unprecedented, event. The man continues to speak throughout these visual transitions, explaining the concepts presented.

A man with dark, curly hair and a beard, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, stands in front of a teal blue wall, looking directly at the camera and speaking. His facial expressions subtly change with his words, occasionally raising his eyebrows or widening his eyes for emphasis. Behind him, wooden shelf letters spell out "THINK TANK" against the wall. The shelves are filled with various colorful and distinct objects: on the left, an orange toy car, a clear glass sphere, a yellow hard hat, a blue Doctor Who TARDIS model, and other small items; on the right, a small white fluffy creature, a lime green animal toy, a purple horned creature, a small white figurine, and a brown head sculpture. The letter "O" in "TANK" is a circular shelf adorned with an eye design.

A man with dark, curly hair and a beard, wearing a gray t-shirt, stands in front of a blue wall with wooden shelves spelling out "THUNK." Various colorful figurines and objects, including an orange car, a yellow blob, a blue robot, a white creature, a green frog-like figure, a golden orb, a purple unicorn, and a grey helmet, adorn the shelves. From 0:00 to 0:17, the man speaks directly to the camera, occasionally widening his eyes and using hand gestures. At 0:17, a semi-transparent overlay of an airport terminal with people sitting in waiting areas and airplanes visible through large windows is superimposed over the man and the background. The man maintains a wide-eyed, surprised expression during this overlay. The airport overlay fades at 0:21, returning to the original background. The man continues speaking, briefly resting his finger on his chin as if in thought, and then points his index finger at the camera at 0:28. From 0:29 to 0:34, the scene transitions to an end screen. The man, with his left arm raised and right finger pointing, is on the left, while the right side of the screen features two black boxes labeled "If you liked that episode, try this one!" and "If you enjoy this subject, try this whole dang playlist!" (English translation of the text on the screen: "If you liked that episode, try this one!" and "If you enjoy this subject, try this whole dang playlist!"). A circular placeholder is in the top middle. Text at the top left reads, "Many thanks to Liz Ballinger for her help with this weeks' episode!" (English translation of the text on the screen: "Many thanks to Liz Ballinger for her help with this weeks' episode!"). A banner at the bottom states, "BE SURE TO CHECK OUT THE VIDEO DESCRIPTION FOR FURTHER READING!" (English translation of the text on the screen: "BE SURE TO CHECK OUT THE VIDEO DESCRIPTION FOR FURTHER READING!") along with social media handles and an email address for "THUNKShow" and "THUNK@gmail.com". Additional text at the bottom right states "AUDIO INTERFACE & MORE CONTENT AT: THUNKShow.com" (English translation of the text on the screen: "AUDIO INTERFACE & MORE CONTENT AT: THUNKShow.com").
